prompt.project_info: Create a 3x3 studio portrait grid of the same approved adult performer with varied expressions.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with large expressive eyes, natural bright skin, long dark voluminous waves, vibrant red opaque dress with secure straps, and polished K-pop-inspired makeup without copying a public figure.
prompt.composition_elements: Nine equal cells: selfie smile, wink, surprised look, pout, joyful smile, playful scrunch, over-shoulder smile, upward laugh, and shy side glance; seamless light-grey studio background and consistent identity/outfit.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: High-budget music-video studio light using softboxes and subtle key light, clean highlights, rich saturated red, charismatic polished mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 3x3 grid collage, 85mm f/1.2 portrait lens, creamy bokeh, sharp subject, high-resolution photorealistic studio image, consistent continuity across cells.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic 3x3 portrait grid collage of the same approved adult woman, with large expressive eyes, natural bright skin, long dark voluminous wavy hair, and polished K-pop-inspired makeup. She wears a vibrant red opaque dress with secure straps. The nine cells show: a sweet selfie smile, playful wink, surprised expression, cute pout, joyful closed-eye smile, mischievous scrunch, friendly over-shoulder smile, upward laugh, and shy side glance. Use a seamless light-grey studio background, softboxes and subtle key light like a polished music-video set, rich saturated red, 85mm f/1.2 look, creamy bokeh, sharp subject, and consistent identity and outfit across all cells. Do not copy a public figure.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, strapless dress, exposed chest, sexualized tongue gesture, public figure likeness, inconsistent identity, inconsistent outfit, text, logo, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed.
